shareholders.evidence: Our long-term economic goal (subject to some qualifications mentioned later) is to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Factual, long-form letter voice mixing first-person singular and plural, addressed directly to owner-partners. Shareholders are addressed first and most often, framed as long-term partnership rather than trading. Commitments are mostly absolute (we will never, we do not), though some hedged (we will try, we expect). Distinctive idioms include eat our own cooking and gin rummy managerial behavior. Stakeholders beyond owners are largely absent.
